value.reason: Ticket asks for clarification on how proration/credit works after an upgrade; knowledge chunk directly explains this, so a factual reply is appropriate without needing a refund review.

groundedReply.suggestedResponse: Thanks for reaching out! When you upgrade your plan, the change takes effect immediately. Your account receives a credit for the unused portion of your previous plan, and you're charged a prorated amount for the new plan covering the time remaining in your current billing cycle. This is why you may see both a credit and a new charge reflected on your account. If you'd like, I can look into the specific amounts on your account—just let me know if you have any further questions!

citations.claim: Upgrades take effect immediately, with credit for unused portion of previous plan and a prorated charge for the new plan through the current billing date.
